rules.description: Time-series body has at least 2 rows (first and last sample).
First-sample timestamp is parseable as ISO 8601.
At least one row has a parseable Energy Delivered (kWh) value.
Absolute difference between file first_ts (UTC) and filename connTime (UTC) must be <= 1800 seconds (30 minutes).
Session duration (last_ts - first_ts) must satisfy 0 < duration <= 7 days.
last_ts >= first_ts (subsumed by R6 but kept for diagnostic clarity).
EVSE ID parses as a positive integer < 1000 (Caltech uses 1-56 per acnportal Caltech site config).
(TOKEN-REQUIRED) The last userInputs.modifiedAt entry has a non-null kWhRequested value.
rules.on_fail: exclude from DeltaE distribution; retain for DeltaD

rules.description: (TOKEN-REQUIRED) The last userInputs.modifiedAt entry has a non-null requestedDeparture value.
rules.on_fail: exclude from DeltaD distribution; retain for DeltaE

rules.description: (TOKEN-REQUIRED) The last userInputs.modifiedAt entry has a non-null minutesAvailable value.
rules.on_fail: exclude from baseline fit; retain for distribution fits

explicitly_not_excluded: long sessions (>24h, subject to R6 cap at 7 days)

exclusion_reasons_in_sample.overlap_of_reasons: 1 file excluded by both R4 and R5 (one 3.9h outlier also had empty energy cells); 8 unique files
